olivia (AE): kicking off thread for the Pilot with FinSys - they have an ask around rotating BYO keys every hour during the POC. asking for ops feasibility and any cost delta.
rahul (SE): thanks. quick q — are they asking for full CMK rewrap each hour, or generation of ephemeral DEKs under same CMK?
john.cust (customer): we need to demonstrate that any cached keys are invalidated within 60 minutes to meet our internal compliance. DEK rotation under the same CMK is fine, as long as redeploys and live sessions don't keep old keys in cache.
maria (crypto-ops): technically doable but two caveats: 1) HSM-backed CMK operations have rate limits on some providers; hourly DEK rewraps at high QPS could cause throttling. 2) continuous rekeying breaks long-lived KV caches in our runtime unless we implement a cache-invalidation hook.
olivia (AE): good flags. john, can you share expected peak concurrent requests and QPS for the POC? that'll let us scope rate/latency impact.
john.cust (customer): peak ~200 qps, mostly short completions. POC traffic expected to spike during demo windows to ~600 qps for a few mins.
rahul (SE): at 600 qps, if every request triggers CMK encrypt/decrypt we'll definitely see throttling on some HSM profiles. but if we use prefix/KV cache + DEK rewrap every hour, only rewrap ops are CMK-heavy (one per DEK). we can batch rewraps to a maintenance window.
maria (crypto-ops): propose runbook: steps 1- create DEK per token-bucket (e.g., per minute group) 2- rotate DEKs hourly 3- expose /key-invalidate endpoint to the runtime to flush caches 4- have fallback policy to switch to Redwood-managed keys if HSM limit hit.
olivia (AE): can you draft the SOW language for fallback and specify any surcharge for high rotation rates? customer requested pricing delta.
rahul (SE): pricing note: hourly DEK rewraps increase HSM API usage but not GPU pricing. estimate: baseline POC HSM ops ~1k/week. With aggressive hourly rotation and 600 qps spikes, upper bound ~10k rewraps/week. ballpark surcharge $500-$1,200 for POC usage window depending on provider. need finance sign-off.
maria (crypto-ops): operational checklist we need from customer: - network allowlist for HSM endpoints - service account APis + KMS IAM roles - expected maintenance window for bulk rewraps - acceptance criteria for cache invalidation
john.cust (customer): we can provide allowlist and SA, yes. maintenance window flexible but must occur outside demo times. acceptance criteria: no successful decryption with previous DEK after 60 minutes, verified by test harness.
olivia (AE): legal-bot, any issues with including a fallback to Redwood-managed keys in the trial SOW?
legal-bot: automated note: include explicit customer opt-in/out checkbox for fallback. recommend liability cap language for key custody during fallback.
rahul (SE): technical validation steps for POC: a) run scripted ramp to 600 qps for 5 mins b) trigger hourly rotation and attempt decrypt with old DEK c) verify TTL-based cache eviction and runtime error handling d) monitor KMS throttle metrics and latency tail. we'll produce a short CLI harness and a smoke test.
maria (crypto-ops): sample command we can run during POC to force rotate and validate: ```bash
# rotate DEKs and verify failure
curl -X POST https://redwood.example/api/v1/admin/keys/rotate?scope=poc && \ 
sleep 2 && \ 
curl -sS https://redwood.example/api/v1/keys/verify?key_id=last | jq .status
```
john.cust (customer): nice, that helps. can you also provide a short runbook we can hand to our infra team to automate the allowlist and the test harness?
olivia (AE): will do. rahul/maria, can you drop a 1-page runbook and a short pricing blurb by EOD tomorrow? john, I'll follow up with the updated SOW draft and opt-in checkbox language for fallback.
rahul (SE): on it. I'll include suggested cache TTL defaults and a recommended debounce for rewraps to avoid hotspot rewrap storms.
maria (crypto-ops): adding a note: if they insist on per-request CMK ops (no DEK layer) we may need a hardened capacity plan and a different cost model. flagging to AE and finance. :warning:
john.cust (customer): understood — we'll try the DEK-based flow first. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
olivia (AE): thanks — looping legal and finance after we upload the runbook. milestone: SOW update + runbook + pricing blurb tomorrow EOD.
